frase.texto: I appeal to everyone's sense of responsibility. Let everyone feel personally involved in the lives of these young people, who must always be protected and cared for.

fuente.titulo: Pope appeals for care and protection of migrant children - Vatican News

caption:
“I appeal to everyone's sense of responsibility. Let everyone feel personally involved in the lives of these young people, who must always be protected and cared for.”

— Pope Leo XIV, General Audience (2026)

Via Vatican News, 23 September 2026
